question: By whose command are distributions made reasonably to the immortals?
premises: Distribution is made to the immortals.
It follows the command of the lord of all refuges.
The distributor is endowed with reason.
inference: Reasoned distribution to the immortals is carried out under the supreme lord's command.
plain_english: Endowed with reason, distributing to the immortals by the command of the lord of all refuges.
